Leah (Finance): Heads-up: new billing behavior launching 2026-06-01. Please cascade to any docs or customer comms owners.

Leah (Finance): Summary: we're introducing a short 72-hour 'grace buffer' for quota spikes and an account-level credit smoothing mechanism. Invoices will show a new line called 'grace-reconciliation' so customers can see adjustments.

Tom (Billing): How it works: 1) Grace buffer records bursts within rolling 72 hours and defers immediate overage charges; reconciliation happens at invoice time. 2) Unused free credits from low-usage accounts will flow into an adaptive credit pool applied against overages across eligible accounts.

Rita (Support): Support procedures: escalate any request for manual reversal with tag 'billing-review'. We have a documented 1x manual credit path for verified migration/import incidents. Templates uploaded to #support-templates.

Tom (Billing): Dev notes: webhook now includes `grace_window_start` and `reconciled_amount`. Update dashboards to use `reconciled_amount` for billed views. Raw usage will still be exported for debugging.

Leah (Finance): CSV invoice changes: added columns raw_usage, grace_reconciliation, billed_usage, credit_pool_adjustment. Backwards compatible but update ETLs.

Tom (Billing): Rollout: internal alpha -> opt-in beta (2026-05-12) -> full rollout (2026-06-01). Dedicated/reserved contracts unaffected unless explicitly amended.

Rita (Support): Customer comms: we'll email accounts >10k tokens/mo and show a temporary banner in Console for free tiers. Please flag any enterprise customers who need a personalized note.

deploy-bot: Reminder: billing rollout checklist item due 2026-05-05.

Leah (Finance): Questions or blockers? Please DM me or Tom before EOD Thursday. Thanks :)
